projects.title: Learn, Play & Code with Code Blocks
projects.summary: An interactive learning playground where kids explore coding, puzzles, math, and brain games through fun activities. Designed to make problem-solving and computational thinking engaging through play.

projects.title: Generative AI Development: From Fundamentals to Applications
projects.summary: A structured, hands-on course covering the fundamentals of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, responsible AI, and application development. Includes practical lessons and Python/TypeScript examples for building real-world AI applications.
